dedupe_keys.name: replication code calculated versus measured building energy performance across estonian counties

description: Hatef Hajian and colleagues publish Python replication code for analysing calculated and measured building energy in Estonia. Zenodo lists one open archive under CC BY 4.0. The description covers 15 counties and 2013–2025, with analyses of EPC-class boundaries, socioeconomic gradients, calculated-to-measured gaps, Bayesian non-compliance risk and convergence. The roughly 32,000-record EPC source is an external Estonian building-register release, while county income comes from Statistics Estonia; neither dataset is bundled. This statistical model can calibrate energy-performance gaps or county variation in building-stock simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this analysis code. Coverage is registered Estonian certificates and the paper’s county definitions, not every building’s metered consumption. A limitation is that reproduction requires separately obtaining and licensing the input datasets, and certificate selection may bias county comparisons. The associated paper is described as submitted, not published. No archive was downloaded, code was not run and reported gaps were not independently recalculated.
